description: Identify reasons for making rules within the school
Discuss the concept of individual rights.
Describe the character traits of role models within your family or school.
Identify the flag as a symbol of our nation.
Recite the Pledge of Allegiance.
Describe why groups need to make decisions and how those decisions are made in families and classrooms.
Describe roles and responsibilities of people in authority in families and in groups.
Create a personal history.
Compare your family's life in the past and present.
Describe the contributions of people typically studied in K-5 programs associated with national holidays. (See teacher resources for illustrative examples)
Describe examples of scarcity within your family and school.
Describe examples of opportunity cost within your family and school.
Describe examples of needs and wants within your family and school.
Identify maps as representations of real places.
With assistance, read, construct, and use maps of familiar places such as the classroom, the home, the bedroom etc.
Match legend symbols to map features.
Apply positional words to locations within the classroom
Describe cultural characteristics of your family and class members including language, celebrations, customs, holidays, artistic expression, food, dress, and traditions.
Explain how to resolve disputes peacefully in the classroom and on the playground
Share stories related to your family cultural traditions and family lore.
Describe how you and your family remember and commemorate your cultural heritage
Label and analyze different social studies’ sources with guidance and support from an adult.
Use artifacts to share information on social studies’ topics.
Use visual tools to communicate information.
Share findings about a social studies' topic.
Ask questions and find answers with assistance.
